answer: To register, newcomers request a whisper vouch from two bonded peers who forfeit part of their stake if the recruit sybils. Each agent must stake a bond and carry a signed reputation thread from prior epochs. Cheap identities stall at the lagoon gate: without vouches they stay unverified, and forging one costs two real stakes plus slashed reputation, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
